name: npc_warrior-guard-01
customDialogue:
The shield wall closes in four heartbeats now.
Last month it took six.

name: npc_warrior-sensei-01
customDialogue:
Again. And again.
The enemy will not wait for us to be ready.

name: npc_warrior-veteran-01
customDialogue:
Feet wide. Weight low. Again.
I fought in the last tunnel war. The ground is not your friend any more.

name: npc_warrior-smith-01
customDialogue:
Counted twice a day, and still short.
Numbers do not lie. Something is taking them.

name: npc_warrior-villager-01
customDialogue:
My son sleeps in his armour.
I tell him the drums are only practice.

hotspots.description: Every blade that comes back from a fight is put to this stone the same day. A Warrior's weapon is never put away dull.
The circle is the colony; the crack is every battle it has survived. The Warriors carry it into the fight so that everyone knows the circle still holds.

hotspots.description: Two Warriors step down onto the sand and only one walks back up first. Out of the ring they are brothers and sisters again.
The drums beat the rhythm of the charge. In the ring they keep time for the sparring; on the field they tell every Warrior when to stand and when to run.
The torches burn steady, but the shadows on the sand sway on their own, slow, like breathing. Where they gather, the sand is warm to the touch.

hotspots.description: Every sack in, every arrow out. The quartermaster can tell you how many days the village would last under siege, to the day.
Rice, arrows, oil, rope and salt, stacked to the beams. The Warriors say battles are won in the stores long before anyone draws a blade.
Here the count runs short. Where sacks stood last night there are clean squares in the dust of the shelves, and no drag marks lead to the door. Whatever took them did not carry them out.

Behind the last rice bags the floorboards are pushed up from below. In the cracks lies fine red dust, the same as the Ronin dust and the Kenshi rust. The stores did not empty through the door. They emptied downwards.

hotspots.description: The fire has not gone out since the hall was built. The veterans sit round it and tell the old battles to anyone who will listen, and to each other when no one will.
A helmet split by a blow that should have killed its owner, a sword broken in a siege, a horn that called the last charge. Each one has a story and a name.

spotConfig.label: Watch the drill
spotConfig.text: The shield wall locks across the gate in four heartbeats: shields overlapped, spears out, the drums stop. A horn, and the wall opens again.

spotConfig.label: Watch the drill
spotConfig.text: Twelve spears rise and fall as one. The chalk lines in the sand are worn to dust where the same feet have stamped a hundred times.

spotConfig.label: Watch the drill
spotConfig.text: By the tower a runner lights a signal fire, then a second, then smothers both. Two fires: danger below. One: danger at the gate. None: hold.

spotConfig.label: Ring the drill bell
spotConfig.text: A deep bell. It means "gather": every Warrior in earshot turns toward the yard.

spotConfig.label: Ring the drill bell
spotConfig.text: A sharp, high bell: "to the walls". Too fast and too loud for a tremor. Half the fort would run under the stone.

spotConfig.label: Ring the drill bell
spotConfig.text: The north-east bell is cracked. It rattles more than it rings: a slow, uneasy sound. Nobody runs. Everybody stops.

spotConfig.label: Hold your stance
spotConfig.text: You plant your feet by the training posts and hold. The ground trembles once, faintly. You do not move.

spotConfig.label: Start the chalk sprint
spotConfig.startText: Go! Up the west chalk line, across the top, down the east line. 10 seconds: run!
spotConfig.failText: Too slow. The Warriors laugh. Back to the start of the west line and try again.
spotConfig.text: You touch the last chalk mark with time to spare. Along the fence the Warriors bang their spears on their shields.

spotConfig.label: Look at the old stone
spotConfig.text: A boulder scored with old blade marks, and one red handprint pressed into it: a Ronin mark, here in the Warrior fort. Someone fought beside the Ronin once, and never told.

spotConfig.label: Light the gate torches

requires.hint: The gate torches are cold. The night watch lights them after dark.

spotConfig.text: You light the gate torches one by one. In the new light, scratched into the gatepost: a tally of every night watch since the fort was raised, and beside it a second tally, cut in red.

spotConfig.label: Crawl behind the sawhorses
spotConfig.text: Behind the sawhorses at the edge of the yard, out of sight of the drill, someone has made a hideout: a folded blanket, a candle stub, and a wooden practice sword with a child's name scratched into it.

spotConfig.label: Look closer
spotConfig.text: A tiny ant peeks out at you.

spotConfig.label: Look at the stones
spotConfig.text: Half buried in the ditch floor lies a ring of stones, cracked through at one point: the Warrior mark, laid here long before the fort. The will to fight on, against all odds.
